value.name: reveals parents' handwriting discrepancy
value.description: The woman slides the page into the light and points out that the two parents' strokes differ, making the discrepancy visible to Asha.
evidence: her fingers slid under the edge of the firmer sheet and drew it forward across the blotter, nudging the looser one aside until both her parents' strokes lay clear in the lamplight
She set her fingertip back on the divergence and pushed the page another inch toward Asha, so that the discrepancy sat squarely under Asha's eyes rather than her own

value.name: Lucia urges Asha to look
value.description: Lucia tells Asha to look at the discrepancy while keeping her hand on the page, signaling the importance of what she has found.
evidence: "Look," she said, and the word was steadier than the ones before it, though she did not take her hand away

value.name: Asha questions the diverging lines
value.description: Asha leans in and asks why the two lines never meet, showing she is trying to understand the significance of the handwriting difference.
evidence: Asha bent closer until her shoulder grazed the lamp's brass arm
"Then why do these two lines never actually meet?" she asked, barely above a whisper

value.name: Lucia produces folded letter
value.description: Lucia silently takes a folded sheet from her cardigan pocket and places it over the disputed writing, as if revealing a difficult truth.
evidence: Lucia did not answer; instead her free hand went to the pocket of her cardigan and came out with a folded sheet
and she laid it over the divergent strokes on the blotter and slid her fingers back as if the paper might burn them

value.name: letter names Rosa as heir
value.description: The folded sheet is revealed to be a letter dated two months before the mother's death that names Rosa as the person who should inherit the house.
evidence: It was a short letter in the firmer hand, dated two months before her mother's death, naming Rosa as the one to whom the house should pass for staying
value.time_hint: two months before her mother's death

value.name: silence follows revelation
value.description: After the letter is revealed, everyone falls silent while Lucia avoids looking at the others, suggesting the revelation is emotionally charged and uncertain.
evidence: For a moment none of them spoke
Lucia kept her eyes on the desk rather than on either woman beside her, as though she had set down something she was not sure she would be allowed to pick back
